### Patterns

- warning: analyze/spec-draft-reason.ts imports types from migrations/v1-to-v2/spec-pass.ts, so the general analyze layer depends on a single migration's internals. Move the SpecModel seam types into schema/ or a neutral migrations/types.ts so that migrations depends on analyze and never the reverse. [warning] (rex-cli)
- info: public.ts is the package's only '.' export and the target of the hench and web gateways. Treat it as the contract boundary. The 'dead code' insight is a resolution artifact: teach the analyzer to map workspace package names to their exports entry instead of acting on it. [warning] (rex-core)
- info: web-server → tests-web-helpers (1 edge) means production code imports a test helper. Find that import and invert it so the helper depends on the server, not the reverse. [warning] (web-server)
- warning: pin packages/web/src/cli/** to an orchestration or web-cli zone. As placed, it creates the only real web-viewer → web-server and web-viewer → web-hub import edges, which misstates the browser/server split. [warning] (web-viewer)
- info: schema/v1.ts is also placed here, but the shared contract types used by both sides belong with web-shared. Moving it would make external.ts the viewer's only outbound import surface, as documented. [warning] (web-viewer)
